concept: A few words next to a control in a small level-4 pill, on hover, on focus and on a tap where there is no hover.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a black rectangle tooltip with an arrow, hover only (the browser title, Bootstrap tooltip)
default_to_avoid.why_not: hover-only tips never show on touch screens or for keyboards; a black box ignores the glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a small level-4 pill, the top of the stack, blurred like every pane

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: it opens on hover, on keyboard focus and on a tap, so every input method reaches it

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: a few words in the label size, wrapping before it becomes a paragraph

options: A glass pill on hover, focus and tap
C info icon that opens a popover
variants.picked: A glass pill on hover, focus and tap
variants.reason: A reaches every input (P6) and sits at the top of the stack. B is hover only. C turns a hint into a dialog.

tip.why: a level-4 pill of text next to its control, blurred like every pane

previewWrap.why: in a preview the tip sits above its control, the way it opens

preview.why: drawn in place for documentation, without its fade

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the pill, the same in every theme and on every scene

@fade.why: it fades in at hover pace and never moves
